# Resume bullets

## Rate Limiter Library

- Built a thread-safe C++20 rate limiter with lock-free lookups over a sharded token-bucket table, using 134.2 heap bytes per key at a million short keys (heap-accounting allocator, Ubuntu on WSL2, median of 10 runs).
- Found flooded single keys made every core fight over one cache line; added a read-only denial path, so one hot key serves 153.3M denied calls/s on eight threads, 3.5× its single-thread rate (Ubuntu on WSL2, median of 10 runs, range 116.7–178.2M).
- Verified correctness with 54 tests passing in both measured sessions, Ubuntu on WSL2 (GCC) and native Windows 11 (MSVC), plus ASan and TSan builds in CI.

## Image Quality Gate

- Bounded decoding memory with input limits: a decompression-bomb PNG grew peak server memory by 825 MiB before the limits and 0.9 MiB with them (Ubuntu on WSL2, median of 5 runs).
- Rejected oversized multipart uploads with HTTP 413 in 1.1 ms (median of 5 runs, Ubuntu on WSL2).
- Added a diagnostics endpoint and paired before/after benchmarks: the default POST /quality path changed by +0.06 ms per request (interquartile range −0.19 to +0.29 ms), no measurable slowdown (pooled median of 5 sessions, Ubuntu on WSL2).
- Shipped it production-style with Docker, Prometheus metrics, request IDs and GitHub Actions CI; its 130 tests pass on Ubuntu on WSL2 and on native Windows 11.

## Concurrent Key-Value Server

- Built a multithreaded TCP key-value server with a custom SET/GET/REMOVE/PRINT protocol, capped at 100 concurrent clients by default.
- Load-tested it at 10,711 commands per second with one client and 7,738 with sixteen (observability off, Ubuntu on WSL2, median of 5 runs).
- Measured what its observability costs at sixteen clients: the in-memory event buffer runs at 0.61× and writing every event to a JSONL file at 0.26× the uninstrumented throughput (instrumented builds, median of 5 paired runs, Ubuntu on WSL2).
- Prevented lost updates by guarding shared state with a reentrant lock and persisting every change, so data survives restarts; covered by 54 tests.
